senses.gloss: (√בז, v. בזי II; cmp. בדק) to break, crush.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:14">Erub. X, 14</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 104a:6">104ᵃ</cite>) <he>בּוֹזְקִין מלח וכ׳</he> you may crush salt (lumps) on the steps (that the priests should not slip).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50">Gen. R. s. 50</cite>, beg. (expl. <he>כמראה הבזק</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 1:14">Ezek. I, 14</cite>) <he>כזה שהוא בוזק וכ׳</he> as one who crushes pieces of peat in the stove (when the flames break forth).

senses.gloss: (cmp. בָּזָק) to be split in flashes, to flash (used of the divine spirit).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:6">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>הרוח היא נִבְזֶקֶת וכ׳</he> the spirit flashes in (seizes) one of man’s limbs, … <he>בכל הגוף</he> the entire body.
